yggdrasil_r12_separate_not_admitted.head: 6e2d4a219b1fb62e0124ba053b65b7e3fdd46546
yggdrasil_r12_separate_not_admitted.reason: R12 expects strict DoorKey mission and 7x7 public image, supports 7 actions and caller-supplied carrying/door/reward objective; MG01 gives six fields and legal 0/1/2. No truncation, private state, fake mission, hardcoded objective, silent abstention conversion or action remap is permitted.

protocol.environment: Original Farama Empty/FourRooms via unchanged MG01 make_env and FullyObsWrapper, same four evaluator-only family/seed starts, original env.step only
protocol.training: Exactly original MG01 K4U FIT selected public transitions (48 original episodes, 6114 transitions observed historically); both R8 and R1 receive identical selected six fields/actions/selected rewards and terminal flags, with original R8 ObserveFit acceptance mandatory for every event; R1 separately learns. No fabricated, dropped, relabeled or duplicated examples.
protocol.fit_replay: One authenticated selected feedback stream generated from pinned original source; one native R8/FIT and one original R1 learning operation per selected event; native checkpoint cold restore before live episodes.
protocol.live: Original seeds 9200,9201 for Empty and FourRooms, independent original-env reset for each actor on exact same seed; each actor chooses own next 0/1/2 action, gets actual env.step consequence, observes that own selected feedback only. R8 must issue native BeginEpisode then Choose then Feedback to maintain selected-action provenance; Yggdrasil R1 executes original GridColony.choose/observe. Do not share predictions, original source weights, or either actor's experience after actions diverge.
protocol.evidence: Exact full original image start hashes and six-field equality per pair; all selected original env.step actions, before/after public fields and public image SHA, reward, distinct terminated and truncated flags; exactly-once per-actor native R8 FIT and live counts and R1 local-cell updates; independent cold restores; no private observation or unselected reward; reproducible canonical trace SHA from two genuinely separate OS processes.
protocol.r12: Do not claim both newer variants connected. Keep Yggdrasil R1 as validated counterpart while qualifying Wingless R8. Inspect original R10/R12 imports and reject six-field MG01 input and 7-action split. Later gate must define a separately agreed shared, equal public-observation/action contract for both native architectures before any R12 direct env interaction.
